step_objectives.goal: Create a reliable development foundation for a GA-grade product, without implementing the full feature set yet.
outcomes: A repo structure that can scale to a full production product
KO/EN localization plumbing in Web + Mobile (and shared keys/dictionaries)
Automated quality gates (lint/test/build) runnable from repo root
Manifest + report protocol enforced for seamless IDE/agent switching
constraints: Do not build advanced product features yet (booking, payments, chat, partner portal, etc.). Only skeleton + plumbing.
Do not mandate specific frameworks/tools; choose them and document the reasons.
definition_of_done: ops/manifest.json exists and STEP-0001 is marked COMPLETED with Asia/Seoul timestamps
API has health + version endpoints with passing tests
Web has landing page + KO/EN toggle with a passing smoke test
Mobile has 3 tabs + KO/EN toggle persistence + share demo working + at least one automated test
Root scripts exist: dev, lint, test, build and run successfully (with documented limitations if any)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Seamless switching between IDEs/agents using a single source of truth manifest + step reports.
requirements: Create ops/manifest.json with: project identity, version, steps array including STEP-0001, timestamps, artifacts list
Create ops/PROTOCOL.md describing: how prompts are executed, how reports are produced, how manifest is updated
Ensure STEP-0001 transitions IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED/BLOCKED/FAILED appropriately
acceptance_criteria: Manifest exists before major work begins
Manifest updated at end with correct status and artifact list
Protocol doc is clear enough for a new agent to follow without asking questions

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A clean repo layout and root-level developer experience.
requirements: Folders per required_repo_contract
Root scripts: dev, lint, test, build
Basic CI workflow file exists (install -> lint -> test -> build)
acceptance_criteria: All root scripts run successfully OR are clearly documented if a platform requires separate steps (e.g., mobile simulator)

requirements: infra/docker-compose.yml includes at minimum: postgres and redis (or equivalents IDE chooses, documented)
infra/README.md explains start/stop and key env vars
acceptance_criteria: docker compose up succeeds and services are reachable on documented ports

requirements: Locale type supporting ko-KR and en-US
User type: id, email, displayName, locale, createdAt
Shared translations include at least: app name, nav labels, landing sections, language label, share label
acceptance_criteria: Web and Mobile use the same i18n keys (imported or synchronized; approach documented)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A minimal API surface that proves the stack works.
requirements: GET /health returns {"status":"ok"}
GET /version returns {"name":"PLAYON","version":"<app version>","env":"<runtime env>"}
Automated tests exist and pass for both endpoints
acceptance_criteria: API runs locally with a documented command and tests pass

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A simple web landing that proves KO/EN localization works.
requirements: Landing page with 3 sections (localized): Find games, Book venues, Achievements
Top-right KO/EN toggle that switches all visible text
At least one automated smoke test verifying render + toggle
acceptance_criteria: Web runs locally and tests pass

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A minimal mobile app proving navigation + localization + share plumbing.
requirements: 3 tabs: Home, Explore, Profile (localized labels)
Profile has KO/EN toggle and persists across restart
Home has a share action that opens the native share dialog
At least one automated test for locale persistence / i18n switch logic
acceptance_criteria: Mobile runs in dev runtime/simulator and key flows work

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Explain chosen stack at a high level and why (no code).
requirements: Create ops/ARCHITECTURE.md summarizing: chosen stack for API/Web/Mobile/DB/cache/testing/CI and reasons
Include a short section: how we will productionize (environments, CI/CD, staging, GA gate concept)
acceptance_criteria: Doc is understandable and contains the major decisions and tradeoffs

tasks.name: Local infra

constraints: Localization-first: no hard-coded visible UI text

tasks.name: Tests + quality gates

tasks.name: Docs + manifest completion

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Choose the implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0001.report.json with no placeholders.
